product_name: Voltas Beko 470 L 2 Star Inverter Frost-Free Double Door Refrigerator, Store Fresh+ (RFF493IF, Silver)

reviews.author: AfzelAfzel
Yosshita Poddar
reviews.text:
I have never seen such a poor quality designed product from house of TATA. Shelves, glass and space are so poorly designed that lot of times your fridge door remain open due to insufficient space between shelves, tray and door. Bottom half is so awkwardly designed that you need to learn to manoeuvre it.Overall POORLY DESIGNED WITH SUB STANDARD MATERIALS.I will never recommend to buy this product.
